args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money claimed to implement banker's rounding but was
actually using ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py
failures in the nightly build (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.67 instead
of 2.66). Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN as documented.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py::round_money` was actually implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming banker's rounding.

For example, `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` returned `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`.

## Change

Switch the `rounding` argument passed to `Decimal.quantize` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`. No other behavior changes.

## Testing

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` (branch `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding`) passed.

Fixes the nightly build failure. Requesting merge so this ships in today's release.
